source.text: בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Bless YHWH, my soul. YHWH my God, you are very great; splendor and majesty you have put on,

en.L: Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, my soul. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are very great; [with] splendor and majesty {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are clothed,
en.B: Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, my soul. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are! Splendor and majesty are the robes {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} wear,
en.R: With all that I am, I praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are so great! Glory and royal honor are like clothes {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} wear.

fr.L: Bénis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mon âme. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es très grand ; [de] splendeur et de majesté {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es vêtu,
fr.B: Mon âme, bénis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand ! La splendeur et la majesté sont les vêtements que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} portes,
fr.R: De tout mon être, je loue {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es si grand ! La gloire et l’honneur royal sont comme des habits que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} portes.

sw.L: Mbariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nafsi yangu. Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} u mkuu sana; umevikwa fahari na enzi,
sw.B: Nafsi yangu, mbariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, jinsi ulivyo mkuu! Fahari na enzi ndizo mavazi unayovaa,
sw.R: Kwa moyo wangu wote ninamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, u mkuu mno! Utukufu na heshima ya kifalme ni kama nguo unazovaa.

es.L: Bendice {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, alma mía. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres muy grande; [de] esplendor y majestad estás vestido,
es.B: Bendice {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, alma mía. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, ¡qué grande eres! El esplendor y la majestad son el manto que vistes,
es.R: Con todo lo que soy, alabo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, ¡{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres tan grande! La gloria y la honra real son como la ropa que llevas puesta.

vi.L: Hỡi linh hồn tôi, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật vĩ đại; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mặc lấy sự huy hoàng và uy nghi,
vi.B: Hỡi linh hồn tôi, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại biết bao! Sự huy hoàng và uy nghi là áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mặc,
vi.R: Với cả con người mình, tôi ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật vĩ đại! Vinh quang và sự tôn trọng của bậc vua chúa như chiếc áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mặc.

decisions.choice: a psalm with no title, joined to Psalm 103
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives this psalm no title. It opens and closes with the call that opens and closes Psalm 103 (103:1, 22), and it praises God as the Creator, following much the same order as Genesis 1.

decisions.choice: Bless the LORD, my soul
decisions.reason: As in 103:1.

decisions.choice: clothed with splendor and majesty: royal glory
decisions.reason: Splendor and majesty (hod, hadar) are the glory of a king (21:6; 45:4); God wears them as clothing (93:1).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verses 2-4 go on describing God in a series of phrases, so verses 1-3 end with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: With all that I am, I praise the LORD
decisions.reason: As in 103:1.

decisions.choice: "Hỡi linh hồn tôi, hãy chúc tụng CHÚA" (L, B); "Với cả con người mình, tôi ca ngợi CHÚA" (R), as Psalm 103:1
alternatives: "Linh hồn tôi ơi, hãy ca ngợi CHÚA"
decisions.reason: The psalm opens and closes with the call of Psalm 103 (see the meaning decision), so Vietnamese keeps the same words for it at each level.

source.text: עֹֽטֶה־א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: wrapping [yourself in] light as [in] a garment, stretching out [the] heavens like a curtain,

en.L: wrapping {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} in light as [in] a garment, stretching out the heavens like a tent curtain,
en.B: {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} wrap {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} in light as in a cloak and spread out the sky like a tent cloth,
en.R: You wear light as if it were a coat. You spread out the sky like a tent.

fr.L: {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}enveloppes de lumière comme d’un manteau, qui déploies les cieux comme une toile de tente,
fr.B: {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}enveloppes de lumière comme d’un manteau et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} étends le ciel comme une toile de tente,
fr.R: Tu portes la lumière comme un manteau. Tu étends le ciel comme une tente.

sw.L: ukijifunika nuru kama [kwa] vazi, ukizitandaza mbingu kama pazia la hema,
sw.B: unajifunika nuru kama joho na kulitandaza anga kama kitambaa cha hema,
sw.R: Unavaa nuru kana kwamba ni koti. Unalitandaza anga kama hema.

es.L: envolviéndote en luz como [en] un vestido, extendiendo los cielos como cortina de tienda,
es.B: {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} envuelves en luz como en un manto y extiendes el cielo como la tela de una tienda,
es.R: Te pones la luz como si fuera un abrigo. Extiendes el cielo como una tienda de campaña.

vi.L: Ngài quấn mình bằng ánh sáng như [bằng] chiếc áo, giương các tầng trời ra như tấm màn trại,
vi.B: Ngài khoác ánh sáng như khoác áo choàng và giăng bầu trời ra như tấm vải lều,
vi.R: Ngài mặc ánh sáng như mặc áo khoác. Ngài giăng bầu trời ra như một cái lều.

decisions.choice: light and the heavens: the first works of creation
decisions.reason: Light was made on the first day and the vault of the sky on the second (Genesis 1:3-8). God is pictured putting on light and pitching the sky like a tent (Isaiah 40:22).

decisions.choice: a curtain: the cloth of a tent
decisions.reason: The word (yeri'ah) is a tent curtain, the cloth of the tent itself (Isaiah 54:2).

source.text: הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם־עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: the [one who] lays the beams of his upper rooms in the waters, the [one who] makes clouds his chariot, the [one who] walks on [the] wings of [the] wind,

en.L: who lays the beams of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} upper rooms in the waters, who makes clouds {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chariot, who walks on the wings of the wind,
en.B: who builds {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} upper rooms with beams set in the waters above, who turns the clouds into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chariot and travels on the wings of the wind,
en.R: He built {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home high above, on the waters over the sky. He uses the clouds as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chariot. He travels on the wings of the wind.

fr.L: qui pose dans les eaux les poutres de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chambres hautes, qui fait des nuées {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} char, qui marche sur les ailes du vent,
fr.B: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui bâtit {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chambres hautes sur des poutres plantées dans les eaux d’en haut, qui fait des nuées {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} char et qui s’avance sur les ailes du vent,
fr.R: Il a bâti {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} maison tout en haut, sur les eaux au-dessus du ciel. Il se sert des nuages comme de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} char. Il voyage sur les ailes du vent.

sw.L: anayeweka boriti za vyumba {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} vya juu majini, anayefanya mawingu kuwa gari {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, anayetembea juu ya mabawa ya upepo,
sw.B: anayejenga vyumba {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} vya juu kwa boriti zilizowekwa katika maji yaliyo juu, anayeyageuza mawingu kuwa gari {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} na kusafiri juu ya mabawa ya upepo,
sw.R: Alijenga makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu kabisa, juu ya maji yaliyo juu ya anga. Anayatumia mawingu kama gari {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} la vita. Anasafiri juu ya mabawa ya upepo.

es.L: el que pone las vigas de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} aposentos altos en las aguas, el que hace de las nubes {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} carro, el que anda sobre las alas del viento,
es.B: que construye {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} aposentos altos con vigas puestas en las aguas de arriba, que hace de las nubes {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} carro y viaja sobre las alas del viento,
es.R: Él construyó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} casa en lo alto, sobre las aguas que están encima del cielo. Usa las nubes como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} carro. Viaja sobre las alas del viento.

vi.L: Đấng đặt các xà của những phòng trên cao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong các dòng nước, Đấng lấy mây làm xe chiến mã của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đấng bước đi trên cánh gió,
vi.B: Đấng dựng các phòng trên cao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với xà gác trên các dòng nước phía trên, Đấng biến mây thành xe chiến mã của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và đi trên cánh gió,
vi.R: Ngài xây nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên cao, trên các dòng nước phía trên bầu trời. Ngài dùng mây làm xe chiến mã của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đi trên cánh gió.

decisions.choice: upper rooms on the waters: God's house above the sky
decisions.reason: The sky was pictured as holding back waters above it (Genesis 1:7; 148:4). God's upper rooms, like the cool rooms on a roof, are built on those waters.

decisions.choice: his: from speaking to God to speaking of him
decisions.reason: Verses 1-2 speak to God; from here the psalm often speaks about him, and turns to him again in verses 6-9, 13, 20 and 24-30.

decisions.choice: the wings of the wind: the swift wind
decisions.reason: The wind is pictured with wings, carrying God as he moves through his world (18:11).

decisions.choice: over the sky
decisions.reason: Readable says where these waters are (m1).

decisions.choice: the hymn moves between speaking to God ("tu") and speaking about him ("il"), verse by verse, as the Hebrew does
decisions.reason: The Hebrew itself turns from speaking to God to speaking about him and back; the French follows each verse, as the English does, so the change can be seen.

source.text: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: making his messengers winds, his servants a fire blazing.

en.L: making {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} messengers winds, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants a blazing fire.
en.B: who makes the winds {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} messengers and flames of fire {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants.
en.R: He sends out the winds as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} messengers. Blazing fire serves {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: faisant des vents {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} messagers, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs un feu flamboyant.
fr.B: qui fait des vents {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} messagers et des flammes de feu {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs.
fr.R: Il envoie les vents comme {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} messagers. Le feu qui flambe est à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} service.

sw.L: anayefanya pepo kuwa wajumbe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} moto uwakao.
sw.B: anayezifanya pepo kuwa wajumbe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na miali ya moto kuwa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Anatuma pepo kama wajumbe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Moto uwakao unamtumikia.

es.L: haciendo de los vientos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mensajeros, de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} servidores un fuego llameante.
es.B: que hace de los vientos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mensajeros y de las llamas de fuego {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} servidores.
es.R: Envía los vientos como {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mensajeros. El fuego ardiente {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirve.

vi.L: Đấng làm cho các sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành gió, các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành lửa cháy rực.
vi.B: Đấng khiến gió làm sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và ngọn lửa làm đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài sai gió đi làm sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Lửa cháy rực phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: makes the winds his messengers
decisions.reason: The Hebrew can be read either way: God makes winds and fire serve him, or he makes his messengers (angels) into winds and fire. The verses around speak of wind, cloud and fire in God's service, which favors the first reading. Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: quoted in Hebrews 1:7
decisions.reason: Hebrews 1:7 quotes this verse from the ancient Greek translation, "he makes his angels winds (or spirits)", to show that angels serve while the Son reigns. The Hebrew word (mal'akh) means both messenger and angel.

decisions.choice: a blazing fire: lightning
decisions.reason: Fire here may be lightning, which goes out at God's command (148:8).

source.text: יָֽסַד־אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: He established [the] earth on its foundations; it will not be shaken forever and ever.

en.L: He founded the earth on its foundations; it will not be shaken forever and ever.
en.B: He fixed the earth on its bases, never to be toppled, for all time to come.
en.R: He built the earth on a strong base. Nothing can ever move it.

fr.L: Il a fondé la terre sur ses bases ; elle ne sera pas ébranlée, à tout jamais.
fr.B: Il a affermi la terre sur ses fondations, pour qu’elle ne soit jamais renversée, dans tous les temps à venir.
fr.R: Il a bâti la terre sur une base solide. Rien ne pourra jamais la faire bouger.

sw.L: Aliiweka nchi juu ya misingi yake; haitatikisika milele na milele.
sw.B: Aliisimika nchi juu ya nguzo zake, isipinduke kamwe, kwa nyakati zote zijazo.
sw.R: Aliijenga dunia juu ya msingi imara. Hakuna kitakachoweza kuiondoa kamwe.

es.L: Fundó la tierra sobre sus cimientos; no será sacudida jamás.
es.B: Afirmó la tierra sobre sus bases, para que nunca se derrumbe, por todos los tiempos.
es.R: Construyó la tierra sobre una base firme. Nada la podrá mover jamás.

vi.L: Ngài đã lập đất trên các nền của nó; nó sẽ không bị lay động đến đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.B: Ngài đã đặt trái đất trên nền móng của nó, không bao giờ bị lật đổ, cho đến muôn đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã xây trái đất trên một nền vững chắc. Không gì có thể làm nó lay chuyển.

decisions.choice: the earth on foundations
decisions.reason: The earth is pictured as a building set on pillars or footings (24:2; 1 Samuel 2:8; Job 38:4-6). It stands because God made it firm (93:1; 96:10).

source.text: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל־הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ־מָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] deep like clothing you covered it; above [the] mountains stood [the] waters.

en.L: [With the] deep as [with] clothing {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} covered it; above the mountains the waters stood.
en.B: The deep was the robe {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} put over it; the waters rose and stood above the mountains.
en.R: You covered the earth with deep water like a blanket. The water was higher than the mountains.

fr.L: [De] l’abîme comme [d’]un vêtement {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’avais couverte ; au-dessus des montagnes se tenaient les eaux.
fr.B: L’abîme était le manteau que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais jeté sur elle ; les eaux montaient et se tenaient au-dessus des montagnes.
fr.R: Tu avais couvert la terre d’une eau profonde comme d’une couverture. L’eau était plus haute que les montagnes.

sw.L: [Kwa] vilindi kama [kwa] vazi uliifunika; juu ya milima maji yalisimama.
sw.B: Vilindi vilikuwa joho uliloivika; maji yalipanda yakasimama juu ya milima.
sw.R: Uliifunika dunia kwa maji mengi kama blanketi. Maji yalikuwa juu kuliko milima.

es.L: [Con el] abismo como [con] un vestido la cubriste; sobre los montes estaban las aguas.
es.B: El abismo fue el manto que pusiste sobre ella; las aguas subieron y se pusieron por encima de los montes.
es.R: Cubriste la tierra con aguas profundas como con una manta. El agua estaba más alta que los montes.

vi.L: Ngài đã lấy vực sâu che phủ nó như [che bằng] áo; các dòng nước đứng trên các núi.
vi.B: Vực sâu là chiếc áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phủ trên đất; nước dâng lên và đứng trên các núi.
vi.R: Ngài đã phủ nước sâu lên mặt đất như một tấm chăn. Nước cao hơn cả núi.

decisions.choice: the deep over the earth: Genesis 1:2, 9
decisions.reason: At the beginning the deep (tehom) covered everything (Genesis 1:2), until God gathered the waters and dry land appeared (Genesis 1:9). Verses 6-9 tell that story.

decisions.choice: it: the earth
decisions.reason: "It" is the earth of verse 5: God wrapped it in the deep like a garment.

decisions.choice: the earth
decisions.reason: Readable names what "it" refers to (m2).

source.text: מִן־גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: From your rebuke they fled; from [the] sound of your thunder they hurried away,

en.L: From {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rebuke they fled; from the sound of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} thunder they rushed away,
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rebuked them, the waters ran; at the roar of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} thunder they rushed off,
en.R: You shouted at the waters, and they ran away. When they heard {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} thunder, they hurried off.

fr.L: À {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} menace elles ont fui ; au bruit de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} tonnerre elles se sont précipitées,
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as menacées, les eaux se sont enfuies ; au grondement de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} tonnerre elles ont détalé,
fr.R: Tu as crié contre les eaux, et elles se sont sauvées. Quand elles ont entendu {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} tonnerre, elles sont parties en vitesse.

sw.L: Kwa kukemea {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} yalikimbia; kwa sauti ya ngurumo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yaliondoka mbio,
sw.B: Ulipoyakemea, maji yalikimbia; kwa mshindo wa ngurumo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yaliondoka upesi,
sw.R: Uliyafokea maji, nayo yakakimbia. Yaliposikia ngurumo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, yaliondoka haraka.

es.L: Ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reprensión huyeron; ante el sonido de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trueno se apresuraron a irse,
es.B: Cuando las reprendiste, las aguas corrieron; al estruendo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trueno salieron huyendo,
es.R: Les gritaste a las aguas, y se fueron corriendo. Cuando oyeron {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trueno, se alejaron deprisa.

vi.L: Vì lời quở trách của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng chạy trốn; vì tiếng sấm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng vội vàng rút đi,
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở trách, các dòng nước chạy trốn; trước tiếng sấm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng vội vã rút đi,
vi.R: Ngài quát các dòng nước, và chúng chạy trốn. Khi nghe tiếng sấm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng vội vàng rút đi.

decisions.choice: rebuke: a commanding shout
decisions.reason: God's rebuke (ge'arah) is the shout that drives back the waters (18:16; 106:9; Job 26:11).

decisions.choice: your thunder: God's voice
decisions.reason: Thunder is the voice of God (29:3; 77:19).

decisions.choice: the waters
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject (verse 6).

source.text: יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל־מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה׀יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: they went up [the] mountains, they went down [the] valleys, to [the] place which you founded for them.

en.L: they went up [the] mountains, they went down [the] valleys, to the place that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} founded for them.
en.B: they went up over the mountains and down into the valleys, to the place {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} had fixed for them.
en.R: The water ran over the mountains and down into the valleys, to the place {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made for it.

fr.L: elles sont montées [sur les] montagnes, elles sont descendues [dans les] vallées, vers le lieu que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais fondé pour elles.
fr.B: elles ont franchi les montagnes et sont descendues dans les vallées, jusqu’au lieu que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur avais fixé.
fr.R: L’eau a coulé par-dessus les montagnes et elle est descendue dans les vallées, jusqu’à l’endroit que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais fait pour elle.

sw.L: yalipanda milima, yakashuka mabonde, mpaka mahali ulipoyawekea.
sw.B: yalipanda juu ya milima na kushuka mabondeni, mpaka mahali ulipoyapangia.
sw.R: Maji yalipita juu ya milima na kushuka mabondeni, mpaka mahali ulipoyaandalia.

es.L: subieron [los] montes, bajaron [los] valles, al lugar que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} fundaste para ellas.
es.B: subieron por los montes y bajaron a los valles, al lugar que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} les habías fijado.
es.R: El agua corrió por encima de los montes y bajó a los valles, al lugar que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} le preparaste.

vi.L: chúng lên [các] núi, chúng xuống [các] thung lũng, đến nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập cho chúng.
vi.B: chúng tràn qua các núi và đổ xuống các thung lũng, đến nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định cho chúng.
vi.R: Nước chảy qua các núi và xuống các thung lũng, đến nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm sẵn cho nó.

decisions.choice: the waters went up the mountains and down the valleys
alternatives: the mountains rose, the valleys sank down
decisions.reason: The words can mean that the waters, fleeing, went up over the mountains and down the valleys to their place, or that the mountains rose and the valleys sank as the land appeared. "They" in verses 7 and 9 is the waters, so the first reading is followed here.

decisions.choice: the place you founded for them: the seas
decisions.reason: God gave the waters their own place, the seas (Genesis 1:9-10).

source.text: גְּֽבוּל־שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל־יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל־יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: A boundary you set; they will not cross over; they will not return to cover the earth.

en.L: A boundary {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set [that] they will not cross; they will not return to cover the earth.
en.B: You fixed a limit they may not pass; they will not come back to cover the land.
en.R: You marked a line the water cannot cross. It will never again flood the whole earth.

fr.L: Une limite {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as posée, [qu’]elles ne franchiront pas ; elles ne reviendront pas couvrir la terre.
fr.B: Tu as fixé une limite qu’elles ne doivent pas passer ; elles ne reviendront pas recouvrir le pays.
fr.R: Tu as tracé une ligne que l’eau ne peut pas traverser. Elle ne recouvrira plus jamais toute la terre.

sw.L: Uliweka mpaka [ambao] hayatauvuka; hayatarudi kuifunika nchi.
sw.B: Uliweka mpaka ambao hayawezi kuupita; hayatarudi tena kuifunika nchi.
sw.R: Uliweka mstari ambao maji hayawezi kuuvuka. Hayatafurika tena dunia nzima.

es.L: Un límite pusiste [que] no traspasarán; no volverán a cubrir la tierra.
es.B: Les fijaste un límite que no pueden pasar; no volverán a cubrir la tierra.
es.R: Marcaste una línea que el agua no puede cruzar. Nunca más inundará toda la tierra.

vi.L: Ngài đã đặt một ranh giới [mà] chúng sẽ không vượt qua; chúng sẽ không trở lại phủ mặt đất.
vi.B: Ngài đã định một giới hạn chúng không được vượt qua; chúng sẽ không trở lại che phủ đất liền.
vi.R: Ngài đã vạch một lằn ranh mà nước không thể vượt qua. Nước sẽ không bao giờ lại tràn ngập cả trái đất.

decisions.choice: a boundary for the sea
decisions.reason: God set limits for the sea (Job 38:8-11; Proverbs 8:29; Jeremiah 5:22), and promised never again to cover the earth with a flood (Genesis 9:11).

source.text: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: the [one who] sends springs into the valleys; between [the] mountains they go.

en.L: [You are] the one who sends springs into the valleys; between the mountains they flow.
en.B: You let springs loose into the stream beds; they find their way between the mountains.
en.R: You make springs of water flow into the valleys. The water runs down between the hills.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}] qui envoies les sources dans les vallées ; entre les montagnes elles s’écoulent.
fr.B: Tu lâches les sources dans les ravins ; elles se fraient un chemin entre les montagnes.
fr.R: Tu fais couler des sources d’eau dans les vallées. L’eau descend entre les collines.

sw.L: [Wewe ndiwe] unayepeleka chemchemi mabondeni; zinapita kati ya milima.
sw.B: Unaziachilia chemchemi katika mikondo ya mabonde; zinapata njia kati ya milima.
sw.R: Unafanya chemchemi za maji zitiririke mabondeni. Maji yanashuka kati ya vilima.

es.L: [Tú eres] el que envía manantiales a los valles; entre los montes corren.
es.B: Tú sueltas los manantiales por los cauces; se abren paso entre los montes.
es.R: Tú haces que los manantiales corran hacia los valles. El agua baja entre las colinas.

vi.L: [Ngài là] Đấng sai các mạch nước vào các thung lũng; chúng chảy giữa các núi.
vi.B: Ngài cho các mạch nước tuôn vào lòng suối; nước tìm đường chảy giữa các núi.
vi.R: Ngài làm cho các dòng suối chảy vào thung lũng. Nước chảy xuống giữa các đồi.

decisions.choice: valleys: stream beds
decisions.reason: The word (nachal) is a valley with a stream, often dry except in the rainy season.

decisions.choice: the one who sends: God, spoken to
decisions.reason: The verb is a participle with no stated person. Coming after verse 9, it is taken as still speaking to God.

decisions.choice: You are (L); You (B, R)
decisions.reason: The levels supply the subject (m2); Literal brackets it.

source.text: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They give drink to every animal of [the] field; wild donkeys break their thirst.

en.L: They give drink to every animal of the field; wild donkeys break their thirst.
en.B: Every creature of the open country drinks from them; there the wild donkeys satisfy their thirst.
en.R: All the wild animals drink from them. Even the wild donkeys find water to drink there.

fr.L: Elles abreuvent toutes les bêtes des champs ; les ânes sauvages y apaisent leur soif.
fr.B: Toutes les bêtes de la campagne s’y désaltèrent ; les ânes sauvages y étanchent leur soif.
fr.R: Tous les animaux sauvages y boivent. Même les ânes sauvages trouvent de l’eau à boire là-bas.

sw.L: Zinamnywesha kila mnyama wa porini; punda mwitu wanakata kiu yao.
sw.B: Kila kiumbe cha nyika kinakunywa humo; huko punda mwitu wanazima kiu yao.
sw.R: Wanyama wote wa porini wanakunywa humo. Hata punda mwitu wanapata maji ya kunywa huko.

es.L: Dan de beber a todo animal del campo; los asnos salvajes apagan su sed.
es.B: Todas las criaturas del campo abierto beben de ellos; allí los asnos salvajes sacian su sed.
es.R: Todos los animales salvajes beben de ellos. Hasta los burros salvajes encuentran allí agua para beber.

vi.L: Chúng cho mọi loài thú ngoài đồng uống; lừa rừng giải cơn khát của chúng.
vi.B: Mọi loài thú nơi đồng hoang đều uống nước từ đó; tại đó lừa rừng được thỏa cơn khát.
vi.R: Mọi thú rừng đều uống nước ở đó. Ngay cả lừa hoang cũng tìm được nước uống tại đó.

decisions.choice: every animal of the field: the wild animals
decisions.reason: "The field" is the open country, so these are the wild animals, as against the cattle of verse 14.

decisions.choice: wild donkeys: animals of the desert
decisions.reason: The wild donkey lives free in the dry country (Job 39:5-8); even it finds water.

decisions.choice: break their thirst: quench their thirst
decisions.reason: To break thirst is to end it by drinking.

source.text: עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ־קֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: Beside them [the] birds of the heavens dwell; from among [the] branches they give voice.

en.L: By them the birds of the heavens dwell; from among the leaves they lift [their] voice.
en.B: Close by them the birds of the air settle and call out from the leafy branches.
en.R: Birds build their nests near the streams. They sing from the branches of the trees.

fr.L: Près d’elles habitent les oiseaux du ciel ; du milieu des feuillages ils font entendre [leur] voix.
fr.B: Tout près, les oiseaux du ciel se posent et chantent parmi les branches feuillues.
fr.R: Les oiseaux font leur nid près des ruisseaux. Ils chantent dans les branches des arbres.

sw.L: Kando yake ndege wa angani wanakaa; kutoka kati ya majani wanatoa sauti.
sw.B: Karibu nazo ndege wa angani wanatua na kulia kutoka katika matawi yenye majani mengi.
sw.R: Ndege wanajenga viota vyao karibu na vijito. Wanaimba kutoka katika matawi ya miti.

es.L: Junto a ellos habitan las aves de los cielos; de entre el follaje alzan [su] voz.
es.B: Muy cerca de ellos se posan las aves del cielo y cantan desde las ramas frondosas.
es.R: Las aves hacen sus nidos cerca de los arroyos. Cantan desde las ramas de los árboles.

vi.L: Bên cạnh chúng, chim trời làm tổ; từ giữa cành lá chúng cất tiếng.
vi.B: Gần bên các dòng nước, chim trời đậu lại và cất tiếng gọi từ giữa những cành lá sum suê.
vi.R: Chim làm tổ gần các dòng suối. Chúng hót trên những cành cây.

decisions.choice: branches: leafy boughs
decisions.reason: The word ('ofa'im) occurs only here; it means the leafy branches of trees.

decisions.choice: build their nests; sing
decisions.reason: Readable says what the birds do there.

source.text: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Watering [the] mountains from his upper rooms; from [the] fruit of your works the earth is satisfied.

en.L: Watering the mountains from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} upper rooms, from the fruit of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works the earth is satisfied.
en.B: From {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rooms on high {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} waters the mountains, and the earth has its fill of the fruit of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} work.
en.R: From {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home above, God sends rain on the mountains. The earth is filled with the good things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made.

fr.L: Arrosant les montagnes depuis {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chambres hautes, du fruit de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres la terre est rassasiée.
fr.B: De {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chambres d’en haut {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} arrose les montagnes, et la terre se rassasie du fruit de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} travail.
fr.R: Depuis {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} maison là-haut, Dieu envoie la pluie sur les montagnes. La terre est remplie des bonnes choses que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.

sw.L: Akiinywesha milima kutoka katika vyumba {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} vya juu, nchi inashiba kwa matunda ya kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Kutoka katika vyumba {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} vya juu anainywesha milima, na nchi inashiba matunda ya kazi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Kutoka katika makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya juu, Mungu anaimwagia milima mvua. Dunia imejaa mambo mema uliyoyafanya.

es.L: Regando los montes desde {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} aposentos altos, del fruto de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras se sacia la tierra.
es.B: Desde {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} aposentos en lo alto riega los montes, y la tierra se sacia del fruto de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} obra.
es.R: Desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} casa en lo alto, Dios manda lluvia sobre los montes. La tierra se llena de las cosas buenas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.

vi.L: Từ những phòng trên cao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tưới các núi; đất được no nê bởi bông trái của các công việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Từ những phòng trên cao, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tưới nước cho các núi, và đất được no đầy bông trái từ công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Từ nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên cao, Đức Chúa Trời cho mưa xuống trên các núi. Đất đầy dẫy những điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ra.

decisions.choice: watering from his upper rooms: rain
decisions.reason: Rain comes down from the waters above the sky, where God's upper rooms are built (verse 3).

decisions.choice: the fruit of your works: what God's work brings
decisions.reason: The fruit of God's works may be the rain itself, or the crops and plants that grow because of it (verse 14).

decisions.choice: his, your: speaking of God and to God
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, the psalm moves between speaking about God and speaking to him, here within one verse.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God, who is meant by "his", at the start of the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for both "his" and "your" in the verse
decisions.reason: The verse speaks of God and then to him (see the meaning decision). "Ngài" serves for both in Vietnamese, so the turn shows less than in Hebrew, as in Psalm 89:2; the deity_pronoun setting is kept.

source.text: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר׀לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: causing to grow grass for the cattle, and plants for [the] labor of humankind, to bring forth bread from the earth,

en.L: Causing grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for the labor of humankind, to bring forth bread from the earth,
en.B: He makes grass spring up for the herds and plants for people to tend, so that food comes out of the ground,
en.R: He makes grass grow for the cattle. He gives plants for people to grow on their farms, so that they can get food from the ground.

fr.L: Faisant pousser l’herbe pour le bétail, et les plantes pour le travail des humains, pour faire sortir le pain de la terre,
fr.B: Il fait pousser l’herbe pour les troupeaux et les plantes que cultivent les humains, pour que la nourriture sorte du sol,
fr.R: Il fait pousser l’herbe pour le bétail. Il donne des plantes que les gens cultivent dans leurs champs, pour qu’ils tirent leur nourriture de la terre.

sw.L: Akiotesha majani kwa ajili ya ng'ombe, na mimea kwa ajili ya kazi ya mwanadamu, ili kutoa chakula kutoka ardhini,
sw.B: Anaotesha majani kwa ajili ya makundi ya wanyama na mimea ili watu waitunze, chakula kitoke ardhini,
sw.R: Anaotesha majani kwa ajili ya ng'ombe. Anawapa watu mimea ya kulima mashambani mwao, ili wapate chakula kutoka ardhini.

es.L: Haciendo brotar la hierba para el ganado, y las plantas para el trabajo del ser humano, para sacar el pan de la tierra,
es.B: Hace brotar la hierba para el ganado y las plantas para que la gente las cultive, de modo que de la tierra salga el alimento,
es.R: Hace crecer la hierba para el ganado. Da plantas para que la gente las cultive en sus campos, y así puedan sacar alimento de la tierra.

vi.L: Ngài làm cho cỏ mọc lên cho súc vật, và cây cỏ cho công lao của loài người, để đem bánh ra từ đất,
vi.B: Ngài làm cho cỏ mọc lên cho bầy gia súc và cây cối cho con người trồng trọt, để lương thực sinh ra từ đất,
vi.R: Ngài làm cho cỏ mọc lên cho bò ăn. Ngài ban cây cối cho người ta trồng trên ruộng mình, để họ có lương thực từ đất.

decisions.choice: for the labor of humankind: for people to work
decisions.reason: The word ('avodah) is work or service: the plants are for people to cultivate, or for their use (Genesis 2:15).

decisions.choice: bread: food
decisions.reason: Bread (lechem) is often food in general.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 15 names what comes out of the earth, so the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: וְיַ֤יִן׀יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב־אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: and wine [that] gladdens [the] heart of humankind, to make [the] face shine with oil, and bread [that] sustains [the] heart of humankind.

en.L: and wine [that] gladdens the heart of humankind, to make [the] face shine with oil, and bread [that] strengthens the heart of humankind.
en.B: wine that brings joy to human hearts, oil that makes faces glow, and bread that keeps people strong.
en.R: He gives wine that makes people happy, olive oil that makes their faces shine, and bread that gives them strength.

fr.L: et le vin [qui] réjouit le cœur des humains, pour faire briller [le] visage avec l’huile, et le pain [qui] fortifie le cœur des humains.
fr.B: le vin qui réjouit le cœur des humains, l’huile qui fait briller les visages, et le pain qui garde les gens forts.
fr.R: Il donne le vin qui rend les gens heureux, l’huile d’olive qui fait briller leur visage, et le pain qui leur donne des forces.

sw.L: na divai [inayoufurahisha] moyo wa mwanadamu, ili kuung'arisha uso kwa mafuta, na mkate [unaotegemeza] moyo wa mwanadamu.
sw.B: divai inayoleta furaha mioyoni mwa watu, mafuta yanayozing'arisha nyuso, na mkate unaowapa watu nguvu.
sw.R: Anawapa divai inayowafurahisha watu, mafuta ya zeituni yanayozifanya nyuso zao ziang'ae, na mkate unaowapa nguvu.

es.L: y el vino [que] alegra el corazón del ser humano, para hacer brillar [el] rostro con aceite, y el pan [que] fortalece el corazón del ser humano.
es.B: el vino que da alegría al corazón humano, el aceite que hace brillar los rostros, y el pan que mantiene fuerte a la gente.
es.R: Da el vino que pone feliz a la gente, el aceite de oliva que hace brillar su cara y el pan que les da fuerzas.

vi.L: và rượu [làm] vui lòng loài người, để làm cho mặt sáng bóng bằng dầu, và bánh [làm] vững lòng loài người.
vi.B: rượu làm lòng người vui, dầu làm gương mặt rạng rỡ, và bánh giữ cho con người được mạnh khỏe.
vi.R: Ngài ban rượu làm cho người ta vui, dầu ô-liu làm cho mặt họ sáng lên, và bánh để họ có sức mạnh.

decisions.choice: a face shining with oil: festive joy
decisions.reason: Olive oil on the head and face was a sign of gladness and refreshment at a feast (23:5; 45:8). Wine, oil and bread were the main gifts of the land.

decisions.choice: sustains the heart: gives strength
decisions.reason: To sustain the heart (sa'ad lev) is to refresh someone with food (Genesis 18:5).

decisions.choice: He gives
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence here and supplies its subject.

source.text: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] trees of YHWH are satisfied, [the] cedars of Lebanon which he planted,

en.L: The trees of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planted,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s trees have all the water they need, the cedars {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planted on Lebanon,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gives plenty of water to the great trees {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planted, the cedars of Lebanon.

fr.L: Les arbres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sont rassasiés, les cèdres du Liban qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a plantés,
fr.B: Les arbres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ont toute l’eau qu’il leur faut, les cèdres qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a plantés sur le Liban,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donne beaucoup d’eau aux grands arbres qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a plantés, les cèdres du Liban.

sw.L: Miti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inashiba, mierezi ya Lebanoni aliyoipanda,
sw.B: Miti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ina maji yote inayohitaji, mierezi aliyoipanda juu ya Lebanoni,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaipa maji mengi miti mikubwa aliyoipanda, mierezi ya Lebanoni.

es.L: Se sacian los árboles {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, los cedros del Líbano que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} plantó,
es.B: Los árboles {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tienen toda el agua que necesitan, los cedros que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} plantó en el Líbano,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} da agua en abundancia a los grandes árboles que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} plantó, los cedros del Líbano.

vi.L: Các cây của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được no nê, các cây bá hương ở Li-ban mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trồng,
vi.B: Cây cối của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có đủ nước cần dùng, những cây bá hương {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trồng trên núi Li-ban,
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban nhiều nước cho những cây lớn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trồng, những cây bá hương ở Li-ban.

decisions.choice: the trees of the LORD: the great trees he planted
decisions.reason: These are the great forest trees no one planted but God. Naming God can also mean "great, mighty" (36:7; 80:11).

decisions.choice: the cedars of Lebanon
decisions.reason: The cedars of the Lebanon mountains were the tallest and finest trees Israel knew (29:5; 92:13).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 17 goes on to describe these trees, so the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: where there birds make nests; [the] stork — fir trees [are] its home.

en.L: where there birds make nests; the stork — fir trees [are] its home.
en.B: where birds build their nests, and the stork lives high in the cypress trees.
en.R: Birds build nests in them. Storks live in the tall cypress trees.

fr.L: où là les oiseaux font leurs nids ; la cigogne, les cyprès [sont] sa maison.
fr.B: où les oiseaux bâtissent leurs nids, et la cigogne habite en haut des cyprès.
fr.R: Les oiseaux y construisent leurs nids. Les cigognes vivent dans les grands cyprès.

sw.L: ambamo ndege hujenga viota; korongo, misonobari [ndiyo] nyumba yake.
sw.B: ambamo ndege hujenga viota vyao, naye korongo anaishi juu katika misonobari.
sw.R: Ndege hujenga viota ndani yake. Makorongo huishi katika misonobari mirefu.

es.L: donde allí las aves hacen nidos; la cigüeña: los cipreses [son] su casa.
es.B: donde las aves construyen sus nidos, y la cigüeña vive en lo alto de los cipreses.
es.R: Las aves hacen nidos en ellos. Las cigüeñas viven en los altos cipreses.

vi.L: nơi đó chim chóc làm tổ; con cò, những cây bách [là] nhà của nó.
vi.B: nơi chim chóc làm tổ, và con cò ở trên những ngọn cây bách.
vi.R: Chim làm tổ trên những cây ấy. Cò sống trên những cây bách cao.

decisions.choice: the stork
decisions.reason: The bird (chasidah) is an unclean bird (Leviticus 11:19), most likely the stork, which nests in tall trees.

decisions.choice: fir trees: tall evergreens
decisions.reason: The tree (berosh) is a tall evergreen of the Lebanon; it cannot be named for certain.

decisions.choice: "korongo" (stork) and "misonobari" (conifers) for the bird and its trees
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names a stork and a kind of fir or cypress; "korongo" is the Swahili stork, and "misonobari" the familiar word for tall conifers.

source.text: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: The mountains, the high [ones], [are] for the wild goats; crags [are] a refuge for the hyraxes.

en.L: The mountains, the high [ones], [are] for the wild goats; [the] crags [are] a refuge for the hyraxes.
en.B: The wild goats have the high mountains, and the hyraxes take shelter in the crags.
en.R: Wild goats live high up in the mountains. Small animals called rock badgers hide among the rocks.

fr.L: Les montagnes, les hautes, [sont] pour les bouquetins ; [les] rochers [sont] un refuge pour les damans.
fr.B: Les bouquetins ont les hautes montagnes, et les damans s’abritent dans les rochers.
fr.R: Les chèvres sauvages vivent tout en haut des montagnes. De petits animaux, les damans, se cachent parmi les rochers.

sw.L: Milima, ile mirefu, [ni] kwa ajili ya mbuzi mwitu; majabali [ni] kimbilio kwa pimbi.
sw.B: Mbuzi mwitu wanayo milima mirefu, na pimbi wanajificha katika majabali.
sw.R: Mbuzi mwitu wanaishi juu milimani. Wanyama wadogo waitwao pimbi wanajificha kati ya miamba.

es.L: Los montes, los altos, [son] para las cabras monteses; los peñascos [son] refugio para los damanes.
es.B: Las cabras monteses tienen los montes altos, y los damanes se refugian en los peñascos.
es.R: Las cabras salvajes viven arriba en los montes. Unos animalitos llamados tejones de roca se esconden entre las peñas.

vi.L: Các núi, những [núi] cao, [là] cho dê rừng; những vách đá [là] nơi ẩn náu cho loài đa-man.
vi.B: Dê rừng ở trên những ngọn núi cao, và loài đa-man ẩn mình trong các vách đá.
vi.R: Dê rừng sống trên những núi cao. Những con thú nhỏ gọi là chuột đá ẩn náu giữa các tảng đá.

decisions.choice: wild goats: ibex
decisions.reason: The animal (ya'el) is the ibex, a wild goat of the high rocks (Job 39:1).

decisions.choice: hyraxes: small animals of the rocks
decisions.reason: The animal (shafan) is the rock hyrax, a small furry animal that lives among rocks (Proverbs 30:26).

decisions.choice: small animals called rock badgers
decisions.reason: Readable uses a familiar name and says what kind of animal it is.

decisions.choice: "les damans" for the hyrax
decisions.reason: The hyrax is a small animal of rocky places in Israel. French has a name for it, "daman", which Readable explains, as the English Readable explains "rock badgers".

decisions.choice: "pimbi" (rock hyrax) at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shaphan is the rock hyrax, an animal found in East Africa as well, so Swahili can name it; Readable adds that it is a small animal, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "loài đa-man" (L, B); "những con thú nhỏ gọi là chuột đá" (R)
decisions.reason: The hyrax is a small animal of the rocks (see the meaning decision), not a rabbit; "đa-man" is its name in Vietnamese, and Readable describes it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: He made [the] moon for appointed times; [the] sun knows its going down.

en.L: He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its going down.
en.B: He made the moon for keeping the feasts and seasons; the sun knows the hour it should set.
en.R: He made the moon to show when the festivals come. The sun knows when it is time to set.

fr.L: Il a fait la lune pour les temps fixés ; le soleil connaît son coucher.
fr.B: Il a fait la lune pour marquer les fêtes et les saisons ; le soleil sait l’heure où il doit se coucher.
fr.R: Il a fait la lune pour montrer quand arrivent les fêtes. Le soleil sait quand c’est le moment de se coucher.

sw.L: Aliufanya mwezi kwa ajili ya nyakati zilizoamriwa; jua linajua kuzama kwake.
sw.B: Aliufanya mwezi kuonyesha sikukuu na majira; jua linajua saa ya kuzama.
sw.R: Aliufanya mwezi kuonyesha wakati sikukuu zinapofika. Jua linajua wakati wa kuzama.

es.L: Hizo la luna para los tiempos señalados; el sol conoce su ocaso.
es.B: Hizo la luna para marcar las fiestas y las estaciones; el sol sabe la hora en que debe ponerse.
es.R: Hizo la luna para mostrar cuándo llegan las fiestas. El sol sabe cuándo es hora de ponerse.

vi.L: Ngài đã làm ra mặt trăng cho các mùa đã định; mặt trời biết lúc nó lặn.
vi.B: Ngài đã làm ra mặt trăng để định các kỳ lễ và mùa tiết; mặt trời biết giờ nó phải lặn.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm ra mặt trăng để cho biết khi nào đến các kỳ lễ. Mặt trời biết khi nào đến lúc phải lặn.

decisions.choice: moon and sun: the fourth day
decisions.reason: God made the lights in the sky "for signs and for appointed times" (Genesis 1:14-16).

decisions.choice: appointed times: seasons and festivals
decisions.reason: The word (mo'adim) is set times, including Israel's festivals, which were fixed by the new moon (81:4).

source.text: תָּֽשֶׁת־חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ־תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ־יָֽעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: You make darkness and it is night; in it every animal of [the] forest creeps about.

en.L: You make darkness, and it becomes night; in it every animal of the forest creeps about.
en.B: You send darkness, night comes, and every animal of the woods steals out.
en.R: You make it dark, and night comes. Then all the animals in the forest come out and move about.

fr.L: Tu fais les ténèbres, et c’est la nuit ; en elle rôdent toutes les bêtes de la forêt.
fr.B: Tu envoies l’obscurité, la nuit vient, et toutes les bêtes des bois sortent sans bruit.
fr.R: Tu fais venir le noir, et c’est la nuit. Alors tous les animaux de la forêt sortent et se promènent.

sw.L: Unaleta giza, nao unakuwa usiku; ndani yake kila mnyama wa msituni anatambaa.
sw.B: Unatuma giza, usiku unaingia, na kila mnyama wa msituni anatoka kwa kunyemelea.
sw.R: Unafanya giza, na usiku unaingia. Ndipo wanyama wote wa msituni wanatoka na kuzunguka.

es.L: Haces tinieblas, y se hace de noche; en ella se arrastra todo animal del bosque.
es.B: Envías la oscuridad, llega la noche, y todo animal del bosque sale con sigilo.
es.R: Tú haces que oscurezca, y llega la noche. Entonces todos los animales del bosque salen y andan por ahí.

vi.L: Ngài làm ra bóng tối, và trời trở nên đêm; trong đó mọi loài thú rừng bò ra.
vi.B: Ngài sai bóng tối đến, đêm xuống, và mọi loài thú rừng lẻn ra ngoài.
vi.R: Ngài làm cho trời tối, và đêm đến. Rồi mọi loài thú trong rừng ra ngoài đi lại.

decisions.choice: darkness made by God
decisions.reason: Night too is God's work and serves his creatures (74:16); the darkness is not a power against him.

source.text: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: The young lions [are] roaring for the prey, and to seek from God their food.

en.L: The young lions roar for the prey, and to seek their food from God.
en.B: The young lions roar as they hunt, asking God for their meal.
en.R: The young lions roar as they hunt. They are asking God for food.

fr.L: Les lionceaux rugissent après la proie, et pour demander à Dieu leur nourriture.
fr.B: Les jeunes lions rugissent en chassant, et demandent à Dieu leur repas.
fr.R: Les jeunes lions rugissent en chassant. Ils demandent à Dieu de quoi manger.

sw.L: Wanasimba wananguruma kwa ajili ya mawindo, na kutafuta chakula chao kwa Mungu.
sw.B: Wanasimba wananguruma wanapowinda, wakimwomba Mungu chakula chao.
sw.R: Wanasimba wananguruma wanapowinda. Wanamwomba Mungu chakula.

es.L: Los leoncillos rugen por la presa, y para buscar de Dios su comida.
es.B: Los leones jóvenes rugen mientras cazan, pidiéndole a Dios su comida.
es.R: Los leones jóvenes rugen mientras cazan. Le están pidiendo comida a Dios.

vi.L: Các sư tử tơ gầm thét vì mồi, và tìm thức ăn của chúng từ Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Sư tử tơ gầm lên khi đi săn, xin Đức Chúa Trời cho chúng bữa ăn.
vi.R: Sư tử tơ gầm lên khi đi săn. Chúng đang xin Đức Chúa Trời cho thức ăn.

decisions.choice: seeking food from God
decisions.reason: Even the lion's roar is pictured as a prayer: the hunting animals depend on God for their food (verse 27; Job 38:39-41).

decisions.choice: young lions: lions in their strength
decisions.reason: The word (kefir) is a young lion old enough to hunt (34:11).

source.text: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל־מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: The sun rises; they withdraw, and in their dens they lie down.

en.L: The sun rises; they withdraw, and in their dens they lie down.
en.B: At sunrise they draw back together and settle down to rest in their lairs.
en.R: When the sun comes up, they go back home and sleep in their dens.

fr.L: Le soleil se lève ; ils se retirent, et dans leurs tanières ils se couchent.
fr.B: Au lever du soleil, ils se retirent ensemble et vont se reposer dans leurs repaires.
fr.R: Quand le soleil se lève, ils rentrent chez eux et dorment dans leurs tanières.

sw.L: Jua linachomoza; wanarudi, na kujilaza mapangoni mwao.
sw.B: Jua linapochomoza wanarudi pamoja na kulala kupumzika mapangoni mwao.
sw.R: Jua linapochomoza, wanarudi nyumbani na kulala mapangoni mwao.

es.L: Sale el sol; se retiran, y en sus guaridas se echan.
es.B: Al salir el sol se retiran juntos y se echan a descansar en sus cuevas.
es.R: Cuando sale el sol, vuelven a casa y duermen en sus cuevas.

vi.L: Mặt trời mọc lên; chúng rút lui, và nằm xuống trong hang của chúng.
vi.B: Khi mặt trời mọc, chúng cùng nhau lui về và nằm nghỉ trong hang ổ.
vi.R: Khi mặt trời lên, chúng trở về và ngủ trong hang của mình.

decisions.choice: they withdraw: they gather themselves in
decisions.reason: The verb ('asaf, here passive) means to be gathered in, to draw back.

source.text: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי־עָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: Humankind goes out to his work and to his labor until evening.

en.L: {{gender:A person|Man}} goes out to {{gender:their|his}} work and to {{gender:their|his}} labor until evening.
en.B: Then human beings head out to their work and keep at their tasks till evening.
en.R: Then people go out to work. They do their jobs until the evening.

fr.L: {{gender:L’être humain|L’homme}} sort pour son ouvrage et pour son travail jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Alors les humains partent à leur travail et restent à leur tâche jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Alors les gens partent travailler. Ils font leur travail jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Mwanadamu anatoka kwenda kwenye kazi yake na kwenye shughuli yake mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Ndipo wanadamu wanatoka kwenda kazini na kuendelea na shughuli zao mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Ndipo watu wanatoka kwenda kazini. Wanafanya kazi zao mpaka jioni.

es.L: {{gender:El ser humano|El hombre}} sale a su trabajo y a su labor hasta la tarde.
es.B: Entonces los seres humanos salen a su trabajo y siguen en sus tareas hasta la tarde.
es.R: Entonces la gente sale a trabajar. Hacen sus tareas hasta la tarde.

vi.L: Con người đi ra làm công việc mình và lao động cho đến chiều tối.
vi.B: Bấy giờ con người ra đi làm việc và miệt mài với công việc cho đến chiều.
vi.R: Rồi người ta ra đi làm việc. Họ làm công việc của mình cho đến chiều tối.

decisions.choice: humankind: people in general
decisions.reason: The word ('adam) means human beings; the singular "his" refers to any person.

decisions.choice: the day for people, the night for animals
decisions.reason: When the animals go to their dens (verse 22), people go out; each has its time in God's order.

decisions.choice: A person, their (with "Man", "his" as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: The word means any human being (m1), so Literal gives inclusive wording by default with the traditional words as the alternative; Balanced and Readable say "human beings" and "people".

decisions.choice: Then
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the link with verse 22 clear (m2).

decisions.choice: "con người", "mình" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "con người" already means people in general, men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the English gender setting to switch to.

source.text: מָֽה־רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ׀יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: How many are your works, YHWH! All of them in wisdom you have made; full [is] the earth [of] your possessions.

en.L: How many are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! All of them in wisdom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made; the earth is full of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} possessions.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how many and varied {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works are! You made them all with skill and wisdom; the earth is crowded with what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made so many things! You made them all with great wisdom. The earth is full of the creatures {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made.

fr.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres sont nombreuses, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Toutes, avec sagesse, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as faites ; la terre est pleine de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} biens.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres sont nombreuses et variées ! Tu les as toutes faites avec habileté et sagesse ; la terre est remplie de ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait tant de choses ! Tu les as toutes faites avec une grande sagesse. La terre est pleine des créatures que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.

sw.L: Jinsi zilivyo nyingi kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Zote umezifanya kwa hekima; nchi imejaa mali {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni nyingi na za kila aina! Umezifanya zote kwa ustadi na hekima; nchi imejaa vitu ulivyoviumba.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umefanya vitu vingi mno! Umevifanya vyote kwa hekima kuu. Dunia imejaa viumbe ulivyoviumba.

es.L: ¡Cuán numerosas son {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Todas ellas con sabiduría las hiciste; la tierra está llena de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} posesiones.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡qué numerosas y variadas son {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras! Todas las hiciste con habilidad y sabiduría; la tierra rebosa de lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho tantas cosas! Todas las hiciste con gran sabiduría. La tierra está llena de las criaturas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste.

vi.L: Các công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhiều biết bao, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài đã làm ra tất cả chúng bằng sự khôn ngoan; đất đầy dẫy của cải của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật nhiều và muôn vẻ biết bao! Ngài đã làm ra tất cả bằng tài khéo và sự khôn ngoan; đất đầy dẫy những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tạo nên.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ra thật nhiều thứ! Ngài đã làm ra tất cả bằng sự khôn ngoan lớn lao. Đất đầy dẫy những sinh vật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên.

decisions.choice: wisdom: skill in making
decisions.reason: Wisdom (chokhmah) includes the skill of a craftsman; God made the world with wisdom (Proverbs 3:19; 8:22-31).

decisions.choice: your possessions: what you have made and own
decisions.reason: The word (qinyan) is what someone has made or acquired; everything on earth is God's because he made it (Genesis 14:19).

decisions.choice: what you have made (B); the creatures you made (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what God's possessions are here (m2).

source.text: זֶ֤ה׀הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם־רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם־גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is] the sea, great and wide of hands; there [are] moving things, and there is no number, living things small with great.

en.L: This [is] the sea, great and wide on both hands; there [are] moving things without number, living things small with great.
en.B: Look at the sea, so vast and reaching out on every side! It swarms with countless creatures, living things tiny and huge.
en.R: Look at the sea! It is so big and wide. It is full of more living things than anyone can count, both small and large.

fr.L: Voici la mer, grande et large des deux côtés ; là [sont] des êtres qui remuent, sans nombre, des êtres vivants petits avec grands.
fr.B: Regarde la mer, si vaste, qui s’étend de tous côtés ! Elle fourmille de créatures sans nombre, des êtres vivants minuscules et immenses.
fr.R: Regarde la mer ! Elle est si grande et si large. Elle est pleine de plus d’êtres vivants qu’on ne peut en compter, des petits et des grands.

sw.L: Hii [ndiyo] bahari, kubwa na pana pande zote; humo [kuna] viumbe vitambaavyo visivyo na idadi, viumbe hai vidogo pamoja na vikubwa.
sw.B: Itazame bahari, kubwa mno na iliyoenea kila upande! Imejaa viumbe visivyohesabika, viumbe hai vidogo kabisa na vikubwa mno.
sw.R: Itazame bahari! Ni kubwa na pana sana. Imejaa viumbe hai wengi kuliko mtu yeyote awezavyo kuhesabu, wadogo na wakubwa.

es.L: He aquí el mar, grande y ancho de manos; allí [hay] seres que se mueven sin número, seres vivientes pequeños con grandes.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} el mar, tan inmenso y extendido por todos lados! Está repleto de criaturas sin número, seres vivientes diminutos y enormes.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} el mar! Es muy grande y ancho. Está lleno de más seres vivos de los que nadie puede contar, pequeños y grandes.

vi.L: Đây [là] biển, lớn và rộng cả hai bên; trong đó [có] những loài bò lúc nhúc không kể xiết, những sinh vật nhỏ cùng với lớn.
vi.B: Hãy nhìn biển cả, mênh mông và trải rộng mọi phía! Biển đầy dẫy vô số sinh vật, nhỏ bé lẫn khổng lồ.
vi.R: Hãy nhìn biển kìa! Biển thật lớn và rộng. Biển đầy những sinh vật nhiều hơn số ai có thể đếm được, cả nhỏ lẫn lớn.

decisions.choice: wide of hands: stretching out on every side
decisions.reason: "Hands" here are sides; the sea reaches as far as one can see in every direction.

decisions.choice: moving things: the creatures of the fifth day
decisions.reason: The words recall Genesis 1:20-21, where God fills the waters with swarming creatures.

source.text: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה־יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק־בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: There ships go about; Leviathan, this [one] you formed to play in it.

en.L: There ships go about; Leviathan, this one {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} formed to play in it.
en.B: Ships travel across it, and so does Leviathan, the creature {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} shaped to play in its waves.
en.R: Ships sail on it. The great sea monster Leviathan is there too. You made it to play in the sea.

fr.L: Là vont et viennent les navires ; le Léviathan, celui-là, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as formé pour y jouer.
fr.B: Les navires la parcourent, et le Léviathan aussi, la créature que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as façonnée pour jouer dans ses vagues.
fr.R: Les bateaux naviguent dessus. Le grand monstre de la mer, le Léviathan, est là aussi. Tu l’as fait pour qu’il joue dans la mer.

sw.L: Huko meli zinapita; Lewiathani, huyu uliyemuumba acheze humo.
sw.B: Meli zinasafiri juu yake, naye Lewiathani pia, kiumbe uliyemfinyanga acheze katika mawimbi yake.
sw.R: Meli zinasafiri juu yake. Lewiathani, mnyama mkubwa wa baharini, yuko huko pia. Ulimuumba acheze baharini.

es.L: Allí andan las naves; el Leviatán, este que formaste para jugar en él.
es.B: Los barcos lo surcan, y también el Leviatán, la criatura que formaste para que jugara en sus olas.
es.R: Los barcos navegan en él. El gran monstruo marino Leviatán también está allí. Tú lo hiciste para jugar en el mar.

vi.L: Tại đó tàu bè qua lại; Lê-vi-a-than, con vật này {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên để đùa giỡn trong đó.
vi.B: Tàu bè đi lại trên biển, và Lê-vi-a-than cũng vậy, sinh vật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên để vui đùa giữa sóng nước.
vi.R: Tàu thuyền đi lại trên biển. Con quái vật biển to lớn Lê-vi-a-than cũng ở đó. Ngài đã làm ra nó để đùa giỡn trong biển.

decisions.choice: Leviathan: a great sea creature
decisions.reason: Leviathan is a monster of the sea. Elsewhere it stands for chaos and the powers God defeats (74:14; Isaiah 27:1); here it is only one of God's creatures, made to play.

decisions.choice: to play in it: in the sea
decisions.reason: "In it" may be the sea, or the words may mean that God formed Leviathan to play with it, as the book of Job asks whether anyone could play with it as with a bird.

decisions.choice: the great sea monster Leviathan
decisions.reason: Readable says what Leviathan is (m1).

decisions.choice: "Lê-vi-a-than" kept as a name
decisions.reason: Leviathan is a great sea creature (see the meaning decision); naming it as one known animal would narrow the picture, so Vietnamese keeps the name, as the English does, and Readable adds "con quái vật biển" (sea monster).

source.text: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: All of them to you look, to give their food in its time.

en.L: All of them look to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to give [them] their food in its time.
en.B: Every one of them waits for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to give them food when it is needed.
en.R: All these creatures depend on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to feed them when they need it.

fr.L: Tous, ils regardent vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [leur] donnes leur nourriture en son temps.
fr.B: Tous attendent de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur donnes à manger au moment voulu.
fr.R: Toutes ces créatures comptent sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour les nourrir quand elles en ont besoin.

sw.L: Hao wote wanakutazamia, uwape chakula chao kwa wakati wake.
sw.B: Kila mmoja wao anakusubiri uwape chakula wanapokihitaji.
sw.R: Viumbe hivi vyote vinakutegemea uvilishe vinapohitaji chakula.

es.L: Todos ellos esperan en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, para que [les] des su comida a su tiempo.
es.B: Todos ellos esperan de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} que les des su alimento cuando lo necesitan.
es.R: Todas estas criaturas dependen de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para que las alimentes cuando lo necesitan.

vi.L: Tất cả chúng đều trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho [chúng] thức ăn đúng thời điểm.
vi.B: Mọi loài đều chờ đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban thức ăn cho chúng khi chúng cần.
vi.R: Tất cả những sinh vật ấy đều nhờ cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho chúng ăn khi chúng cần.

decisions.choice: the same words in 145:15
decisions.reason: Psalm 145:15 says nearly the same: "the eyes of all look to you".

decisions.choice: look to you: wait with hope
decisions.reason: The verb (sibber) means to wait with hope and expectation.

source.text: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: You give to them; they gather [it]; you open your hand; they are satisfied [with] good.

en.L: You give to them, they gather [it] up; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} open {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, they are satisfied [with] good.
en.B: You hand it out and they pick it up; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} open {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, and they eat their fill of good things.
en.R: You give them food, and they collect it. You open {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, and they have plenty of good things to eat.

fr.L: Tu leur donnes, ils [la] ramassent ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ouvres {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main, ils sont rassasiés [de] bien.
fr.B: Tu distribues et ils ramassent ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ouvres {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main, et ils se rassasient de bonnes choses.
fr.R: Tu leur donnes à manger, et ils ramassent la nourriture. Tu ouvres {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main, et ils ont plein de bonnes choses à manger.

sw.L: Unawapa, wanakiokota; unaufumbua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, wanashiba mema.
sw.B: Unawagawia, nao wanakiokota; unaufungua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nao wanashiba vitu vizuri.
sw.R: Unawapa chakula, nao wanakikusanya. Unaufungua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nao wanapata vitu vingi vizuri vya kula.

es.L: Les das, [lo] recogen; abres {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano, se sacian [de] bien.
es.B: Tú se lo repartes y ellos lo recogen; abres {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano, y comen hasta saciarse de cosas buenas.
es.R: Tú les das comida, y ellos la recogen. Abres {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano, y tienen muchas cosas buenas para comer.

vi.L: Ngài ban cho chúng, chúng nhặt [lấy]; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng được no nê [điều] tốt lành.
vi.B: Ngài ban ra và chúng nhặt lấy; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở tay ra, và chúng được ăn no những điều tốt lành.
vi.R: Ngài cho chúng thức ăn, và chúng gom lấy. Ngài mở tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và chúng có nhiều điều tốt lành để ăn.

decisions.choice: you give, they gather: when you give
decisions.reason: The short clauses set what God does beside what follows from it: when he gives, they gather; when he opens his hand, they are filled.

decisions.choice: open your hand: give freely

source.text: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל־עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: You hide your face; they are terrified; you gather their breath; they expire, and to their dust they return.

en.L: You hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, they are terrified; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gather in their breath, they breathe their last, and to their dust they return.
en.B: If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face away, they panic; if {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} withdraw their breath, they breathe their last and go back to the dust they came from.
en.R: If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turn away from them, they are frightened. If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} take their breath from them, they die and become dust again.

fr.L: Tu caches {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, ils sont épouvantés ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} retires leur souffle, ils expirent, et à leur poussière ils retournent.
fr.B: Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} détournes {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} visage, ils s’affolent ; si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reprends leur souffle, ils rendent le dernier soupir et retournent à la poussière d’où ils viennent.
fr.R: Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} détournes d’eux, ils ont peur. Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur enlèves le souffle, ils meurent et redeviennent poussière.

sw.L: Unaficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, wanafadhaika; unaondoa pumzi yao, wanakata roho, na kurudi mavumbini mwao.
sw.B: Ukiugeuza uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mbali, wanaingiwa na hofu; ukiiondoa pumzi yao, wanakata roho na kurudi kwenye mavumbi walimotoka.
sw.R: Ukiwageuzia mgongo, wanaogopa. Ukiwaondolea pumzi yao, wanakufa na kuwa mavumbi tena.

es.L: Escondes {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, se espantan; recoges su aliento, expiran, y a su polvo vuelven.
es.B: Si apartas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, se aterran; si les quitas el aliento, mueren y vuelven al polvo del que salieron.
es.R: Si {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alejas de ellos, tienen miedo. Si les quitas el aliento, mueren y se vuelven polvo otra vez.

vi.L: Ngài ẩn mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng kinh hoàng; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thu lại hơi thở của chúng, chúng tắt thở, và trở về bụi đất của chúng.
vi.B: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngoảnh mặt đi, chúng hoảng sợ; nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rút hơi thở của chúng lại, chúng tắt thở và trở về với bụi đất là nơi chúng từ đó mà ra.
vi.R: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay đi khỏi chúng, chúng sợ hãi. Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lấy hơi thở của chúng đi, chúng chết và trở lại thành bụi đất.

decisions.choice: hide your face: withdraw your care
decisions.reason: As in 102:3: when God turns his face away, his creatures are left without the life and help he gives.

decisions.choice: their breath: the breath of life
decisions.reason: The word (ruach) is breath, wind and spirit. Here it is the breath of life, which God gives (verse 30) and takes away.

decisions.choice: to their dust they return: Genesis 3:19
decisions.reason: The words recall Genesis 3:19 and 103:14: living things are made of dust and go back to it (Ecclesiastes 12:7).

source.text: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: You send forth your spirit; they are created, and you renew [the] face of [the] ground.

en.L: You send forth {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} spirit, they are created, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} renew the face of the ground.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} send {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} spirit out, they come into being, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make the face of the land new.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} send out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} breath of life, and new creatures are made. You make the land fresh and new again.

fr.L: Tu envoies {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} esprit, ils sont créés, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} renouvelles la face du sol.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} envoies {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} esprit, ils viennent à l’existence, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rends neuve la face de la terre.
fr.R: Puis {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} envoies {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} souffle de vie, et de nouvelles créatures sont faites. Tu rends la terre fraîche et neuve.

sw.L: Unaituma roho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, wanaumbwa, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unaufanya upya uso wa ardhi.
sw.B: Unapoituma roho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, wanaanza kuwako, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unaufanya upya uso wa nchi.
sw.R: Kisha unaituma pumzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ya uhai, na viumbe vipya vinaumbwa. Unaifanya nchi kuwa mbichi na mpya tena.

es.L: Envías {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} espíritu, son creados, y renuevas la faz de la tierra.
es.B: Cuando envías {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} espíritu, llegan a existir, y renuevas la faz de la tierra.
es.R: Entonces envías {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aliento de vida, y se crean nuevas criaturas. Haces que la tierra vuelva a estar fresca y nueva.

vi.L: Ngài sai thần linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra, chúng được tạo dựng, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm mới lại mặt đất.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai thần linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra, chúng được tạo thành, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm mới lại mặt đất.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thổi hơi sống của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra, và những sinh vật mới được dựng nên. Ngài làm cho đất tươi mới trở lại.

decisions.choice: your spirit: your life-giving breath
decisions.reason: The same word (ruach) is "their breath" in verse 29. God's breath gives life to every creature (Genesis 2:7; Job 33:4). Many readers also see here the Spirit of God at work in creation (Genesis 1:2).

decisions.choice: they are created: new life comes
decisions.reason: The verb (bara') is used only of God's creating. Each new generation of creatures is his new work.

decisions.choice: your breath of life
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's spirit does here, keeping the link with "breath" in verse 29 (m1).

decisions.choice: "roho yako" (your spirit) at Literal and Balanced; "pumzi yako ya uhai" (your breath of life) at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ruach is both breath and spirit; verse 29 has just used it for the creatures' breath. Swahili "roho" also covers the breath of life, and small letters leave the sense open as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "thần linh của Ngài" in lowercase (L, B); "hơi sống của Ngài" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the word is God's life-giving breath (see the meaning decision), so it is written in lowercase, like the English "spirit"; Readable says "breath of life", as the English Readable does.

source.text: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

records.literal_gloss: May [the] glory of YHWH be forever; may YHWH rejoice in his works,

en.L: May the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be forever; may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rejoice in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works,
en.B: Let the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stand forever; let {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be glad in the things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made,
en.R: Let {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s glory last forever! May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be happy with all that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made.

fr.L: Que la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} soit pour toujours ; que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se réjouisse de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres,
fr.B: Que la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} demeure à jamais ; que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} trouve {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} joie dans ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait,
fr.R: Que la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dure pour toujours ! Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit heureux de tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait.

sw.L: Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na uwe wa milele; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na azifurahie kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}},
sw.B: Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na udumu milele; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na afurahie vitu alivyovifanya,
sw.R: Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na udumu milele! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na afurahie yote aliyoyafanya.

es.L: Sea la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para siempre; alégrese {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras,
es.B: Que la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} permanezca para siempre; que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se goce en las cosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho,
es.R: ¡Que la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} dure para siempre! Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté feliz con todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.

vi.L: Nguyện vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} còn đến đời đời; nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vui mừng trong các công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Nguyện vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} còn mãi mãi; nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vui thỏa trong những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ra,
vi.R: Nguyện vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} còn mãi mãi! Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vui lòng về mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ra.

decisions.choice: rejoice in his works: Genesis 1:31
decisions.reason: God saw all he had made and it was very good (Genesis 1:31). The psalmist prays that God will go on delighting in his creation.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 32 describes this God, so the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: the [one who] looks at the earth and it trembles; he touches the mountains and they smoke.

en.L: who looks at the earth and it trembles; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} touches the mountains and they smoke.
en.B: who glances at the earth and it quakes, who touches the mountains and they send up smoke.
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} looks at the earth, it shakes. When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} touches the mountains, they pour out smoke.

fr.L: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui regarde la terre, et elle tremble ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} touche les montagnes, et elles fument.
fr.B: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui jette un regard sur la terre, et elle frémit, qui touche les montagnes, et elles se mettent à fumer.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} regarde la terre, elle tremble. Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} touche les montagnes, elles crachent de la fumée.

sw.L: anayeitazama nchi nayo inatetemeka; anaigusa milima nayo inatoa moshi.
sw.B: anayeitupia nchi jicho nayo inatikisika, anayeigusa milima nayo inafuka moshi.
sw.R: Anapoitazama dunia, inatikisika. Anapoigusa milima, inatoa moshi.

es.L: el que mira a la tierra, y ella tiembla; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} toca los montes, y humean.
es.B: que mira a la tierra y esta se estremece, que toca los montes y echan humo.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mira la tierra, ella tiembla. Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} toca los montes, echan humo.

vi.L: Đấng nhìn xuống đất thì đất run rẩy; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm đến núi thì núi bốc khói.
vi.B: Đấng chỉ nhìn đất là đất rung chuyển, Đấng chạm đến núi là núi bốc khói.
vi.R: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhìn xuống đất, đất rung chuyển. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm đến các núi, núi bốc khói.

decisions.choice: smoking mountains: Sinai
decisions.reason: When the LORD came down on Mount Sinai, it smoked and shook (Exodus 19:18; 144:5).

decisions.choice: the Creator's power
decisions.reason: The God who delights in his creatures (verse 31) is also the one whose glance makes the earth quake.

source.text: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I will sing to YHWH in my life; I will make music to my God while I [still am].

en.L: I will sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in my life; I will make music to my God while I [still] am.
